thread:
maria_finance: Quick postmortem follow-up from the token-ingest outage — we need clear owners + dates for the ledger reprocess, invoice corrections, and customer outreach. Short summary: delayed ingest caused ~120 accounts to show negative token deltas between 2024-11-01 and 2024-11-03.

jake_engineering: I can own the pipeline reprocess and the reconcile script. Plan: dry-run, reconcile preview, then apply patches. Tentative ETA for dry-run: Wed. Need approval window for replay.

sam_sre: We can provision burst capacity for the backfill and add a safe-guard flag to pause auto-crediting during replays. Risks: ledger idempotency + duplicate credits. I estimate 72h to get the flag + infra tested.

sara_support: I'll draft customer comms once we have the CSV of affected accounts + delta buckets. Aim for a single templated outbound and an FAQ. Please tag me when the file is ready.

billing-bot: Automated helper: run `billing reconcile --preview --since 2024-11-01 --until 2024-11-03` to generate the delta preview. Example output:

```
acct_id,delta_tokens,estimated_credit_usd
acct_1234,-420,0.84
acct_5678,-1200,2.40
...
```

jake_engineering: Plan timeline: dry-run by 3725003000 (Wed), reconcile preview and validation by 3725003600, apply invoice patches after sign-offs. I'll upload dry-run artifacts to s3://redwood-billing/replays/3725001234/.

maria_finance: Assigning action items here so it's explicit: jake -> pipeline reprocess + reconcile script (due 3725007200), sam -> feature flag + burst capacity (due 3725004000), sara -> customer comms draft + FAQ (due 3725005600), maria_finance -> final approval for credits + audit (due 3725009000). I'll own the audit sign-off.

sam_sre: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR for the flag and link the risk assessment. Will request review from @jake_engineering.

jake_engineering: Also adding a recurring-pattern check — I saw similar small spikes on a ~3-week cadence in the metrics. I'll add an alert and a weekly rollup test to catch regressions.

maria_finance: Good. Please put all artifacts + the reconcile CSV into the postmortem tracker and reference ticket PM-987. We'll need the CSV for accounting and support ops.

jake_engineering: Done — I'll post the s3 link in the tracker and in this thread when dry-run completes.

sara_support: Will stage the outreach templates; planning a segmented send (high-impact accounts first). Also preparing opt-out instructions for automated credits.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in #finance at 3725004120.

maria_finance: Thanks everyone — short sync tomorrow after dry-run. If any blockers surface, flag them here and we'll escalate.
